strings.Local single-binary agent that plans cod: 單一執行檔的本機代理，可規劃程式設計任務、進行變更、審查 diff 並管理 pull request。
strings.draft, push and open a pull request for: 草擬、推送並開啟 pull request 供審查
strings.plan a coding task from reading the code: 閱讀程式碼庫來規劃任務而不編輯檔案
strings.watch pull request CI and turn failures: 監看 pull request CI 並將失敗轉為審查發現
